reading: Switchboard, Quoted (7.42 in 14a) is the only line that lost ground on Joined, and its judges agree on why. Two things sank it. First, the title: 'plan.' sits alone on its own VT323 line, and system, interaction, type, usability and the skeptic all read that as a broken wrap. Soul and style still loved the lit word as a typed answer on the glass. Second, Quote Board's head was taken as little steel patch cords beside every figure, which feedback, system, interaction and the skeptic called ornament the eye has to step over. Older faults are still open: the page is small, dense and boxy, with 1px boxes inside a rack inside a page; the Plans cell squeezes names onto two lines beside a radar that shrank; the inner racks put the list in a narrow column; Ideas' kind keys wrap to four rows and push More filters to the fold; Settings and Chat open on near-empty 'Ready' tubes; and setup sits above the greeting, so it takes the eye and Tab first. What the judges love, and what must stay recognisable: Home as a sommaire, a map of the whole service in two tiers; the household index along the foot (Wishes, Memory, Family, Status with its lamps, Settings), which usability called the best 'is everything working?' answer in the heat; the bezelled glass with VT323 on it; the tubes sized to their page (radar, late bars, needle meter, weekend screen); the lit Now rail and the Now cell on the month; bare black with one cap; and 0 small targets. To win, the line has to do four things. It has to set the title as one sentence in one face with only the lit word glowing, and keep the glass's typed soul by moving the VT323 to a status line. It has to drop the cords and the boxes for something with a job. It has to give the lists room. And it has to make the switchboard's own line art, the patch lead, the one drawing that joins the machine to the map. The crossing lessons point the same way: every heat's top two joined a frame to a grammar, and Sill Line's stem, rebuilt as Desk's patch lead, took three times when it was short and joined the line's own lit object to its own list.

briefs.name: Switchboard, Patched In
briefs.hypothesis: The line keeps everything its judges love: the sommaire, the household index, the glass, the sized tubes and the Now rail. It removes both things that sank it. The title becomes one sentence in one face with only 'plan.' lit, and the cords are gone. Their place goes to the switchboard's own drawing: a short lit patch lead from the glass case's socket into the Plans cell's NOW lamp. Feedback asked for exactly this in tour round 3 ('patch lines from the map cells to their lamps'), and in 14a style, system and interaction called Desk's version the best graft in heat a. Plate's engraved seams replace the box-in-box frame, which answers the most repeated old fault ('dense and boxy', 'boxes sit in boxes'). Its status foot lets the empty Ready tubes on Settings, Chat, Family and Memory fold away, so those pages give their lists full width. Folio's VT323 status line keeps the typed light on the glass without breaking the sentence. The result should read as the same videotex map, calmer and better connected, and it should close the 0.5 gap to the top four.
briefs.brief:
Start from x14a-settled-cross (sheet.css, templates/, static/). Keep the tokens in palettes/x14a-settled-cross.json except where named below. Keep glow 1.0 and screenGlow 1.0, and keep the light only on the glass, the lead, the NOW lamps, the primary, the lamps and focus.

HOME (templates/home.html, _ask.html, sheet.css)
1. Map grid. Two columns at 64rem and up: the case column at minmax(30rem, 34rem) and the right tier at 1fr, with the gap raised from 1.5rem to 2.5rem. Between tiers, put an engraved seam instead of a gap. The household row stays along the foot across both columns. Drop the 1px .cell border and the box-shadow on Home's cells. A cell is bare ground with its head and keeps its 2px section cap, now only 3rem wide over the head (a tab, not a full rule). Cells are split by seams (see graft C): a horizontal seam between Plans and To do, and a vertical seam between the household cells. That removes one nesting level everywhere on Home.
2. The case. Keep the 3px bezel, the hairline lip and the scanlined glass with its VT323 strip ('Vera' with her small screen at left, 'Friday 2 October' at right). Pad the glass to 1.5rem and give the title 1.25rem of air above the box (soul: 'give the glass room'). The title is 'Send Vera anything to plan.' on the glass, in one run and one face: Plex Sans condensed 600 at 2.75rem/1.05, colour --heading (#eceee8), with 'plan.' wrapped in .lit (full stop inside the lit run). The lit word gets the kit's three-layer halo and a white-hot core (#eafff1 at the centre, 0 0 2px #6dff9c, 0 0 12px rgb(109 255 156/.55), 0 0 32px rgb(109 255 156/.25)). Wrap 'to plan.' in a nowrap span so that if it wraps (phone), it breaks as 'Send Vera anything / to plan.' (Quote's credited break). Remove the block cursor after 'plan.' and remove the VT323 face from the title entirely.
3. The box. Keep it as the glass's last rows, but give it a matte well (--field #0c100e, 1px --edge #6c7671). Set the placeholder in Plex Sans in --dim bone-grey, not green, so it reads as a field (usability). Remove the green '›' prompt inside the field, so nothing glows inside the box until someone writes; on :focus-within the well's edge turns #6dff9c with the kit's focus halo. Under the well, still on the glass, add the VT323 status line from graft B, which carries the case's only block cursor.
4. The deck under the glass: From select, mic, 'Send where I am', and Send (filled #6dff9c, the one primary). The starters become one left-aligned row of three keys sharing the case's left edge (type). Each key is a 44px+ key with its words in Plex Sans 600 and its destination under it in Plex Sans 400 at .875rem, --dim ('usually Plans'), not letterspaced mono. Use an 8px gap. 'Continue with Vera →' stays under them.
5. Setup. Move 'Finish setting up' from above the map to a one-line strip directly under the case's deck in the left column: a 2px amber left edge, a small amber lamp, 'Finish setting up · 1 of 3', and 'Next: choose your own password →' as its link. No box and no amber outline. Glass first for the eye and for Tab (style, interaction).
6. Plans cell (right column, top). Set the head as a contents line with no cord: 'Plans' (condensed 600, --t-cell), a dotted leader (1.5px dotted #3a4348, max 46rem), then the figure '4' in Plex Sans 300 at 2rem in plans sky #93bfe0, then a stacked unit over change in Plex Sans 400 .875rem ('coming' over 'next in 2 days'). Re-lay the cell so the rail and list come first at left and the radar sits at the right. Enlarge the radar back to the parent's scope, 11.5rem, with numbered marks matching the rows' day numerals. Rows: day numeral (Plex Sans 300, 2rem) with stacked weekday/month, a name column of at least 14rem set nowrap at 1.125rem semibold, and ONE stacked fact column ('13:00' in Plex Mono over 'in 2 days' in sans, right-aligned, 6rem). That frees enough width that 'Oaks Park roller rink' and 'Mount St. Helens day trip' sit on one line. The NOW stop sits at the rail's head and receives the patch lead (graft A). Light the rail only from NOW to the first stop (#6dff9c, 2px, with the rail glow); below that the rail is steel #56697b at 1px.
7. To do cell. Same contents head ('To do ........ 4 open / 3 late', with '3 late' an amber link). Keep the rail with square neutral ticks, the amber left edge on late rows and the lit NOW between late and upcoming. Replace the closing line with 'Every thing to do →' alone; drop 'Nothing dated ahead'.
8. Ideas cell (left column, under setup). Same contents head ('Ideas ........ 12 saved / 2 restaurants to try'). Keep the four Lately added rows (icon in its kind's grounded ink, name, for whom, kind word in one ink: pewter #8794a2). Rows get the visible afterglow (graft D).
9. Household index row (the sommaire foot). Keep all five cells as 44px links, enlarged per style: heads at --t-cell condensed, each with its figure and a live lamp. Status shows its lamps: green glowing dot = on, pewter ring = off, amber bar = needs a look (Mapped's shape legend, already in the line). Split the cells by vertical seams instead of a box. This row is the line's signature: make it the clearest thing below the fold.
10. Type step-up across the map (system, type): row names 1.125rem, body 1.0625rem, legends and meta at 0.875rem minimum (no 12px text outside the glass strip), cell padding raised to 1.35rem, and 2.5rem between tiers.

INNER PAGES (_ui.html page_head, every page template)
11. The head row on every inner page: icon, title (condensed 600, --t-title 2rem), dotted leader (short, max 6rem), figure in its section ink, stacked unit over change in Plex Sans 400 (not mono), and the one green primary at the right. Remove .cord and its two end dots from every head (system, interaction, skeptic). Split head and body with an engraved seam (graft C), not a rule.
12. Vary the rack (style, system, interaction: 'racks cramped', 'list in a narrow column'). Only pages with a live tube keep the left rack, now 17rem wide (from 19-21rem):
   - Ideas: rack = radar tube (kept, with Nearest/Furthest), Search, and More filters, which is now above the fold. The Kind filter leaves the rack. Over the table goes a one-line key row: latched 'All' and 'Restaurants · 2' keys (one tap, LED on the latched one), then a native 'Kind' select with a 'Show' key that works with scripts off (usability). The table gains the freed width.
   - To do: rack = the late-bars tube, the Show keys (Open, Late, Done, Cancelled, All as two compact rows), and Search.
   - Status: rack = the moving-coil meter (keep the ghost peak and limit tick) and the lights legend.
   - Plans: no left rack. The weekend tube ('This weekend, 3-4 Oct · Oaks Park roller rink · Next free weekend 10-11 Oct') becomes an inset at the right end of the head band, 22rem wide and the head row's height. List/Month and Earlier/Later sit as one key row under the head, and the month takes the full page width. Keep the Now cell (lit edge and lamp), drop the word 'Now' in it (its designer's own note), and put the calendar note under the month.
   - Settings, Family, Memory, Wishes, the form, Restaurants: no tube and no rack. The list takes the full width (max 62rem for prose), and the status foot (graft C) says Ready.
   - Chat: drop the left rack and its Ready tube. The kids' conversations become a one-line strip under the head ('The kids' conversations: Maya · Theo', 44px links). The thread is one column at max 46rem, centred on the composer's axis. The composer is built like Home's case (same glass lip, matte well, the VT323 status line 'Vera is listening ▊' under it, and the deck with From and Send) so Chat and Home share one ask. Show her glyph screen only on her newest reply, which alone keeps the soft green edge (lesson: only the newest bubble blooms). Older replies have a matte steel edge, which brings Chat's green share under 55%.
13. Colour (lesson: colour is replaced, never removed). Removing the steel cords drops no hue. Plans sky #93bfe0, To do sea #86c6bd, Ideas pewter #8794a2, bone #cdc6b5 for heads' figures where no section applies, amber #eaa76b for late and needs-a-look only (words, edge, small lamp), and the seams' lip as a warm neutral (bone mixed 8% into #232a27). Aim for green at or under 50% of saturated pixels on Home and Ideas, and under 55% on Chat.
14. Phone (home-phone): case (title on two lines broken before 'to', box, status line), deck, starters as stacked full-width keys (credited), the setup one-liner, then Plans with the radar hidden and the list first, so the next plan is in the first screen and a half. No patch lead under 64rem. The household index becomes a 2-column grid of 44px cells.
briefs.borrows:
Its own judges' fixes, most cited first:
(1) Set the title as one run in one face with only 'plan.' lit, the full stop in the lit run, and the VT323 moved off the title onto a prompt or status line: system, interaction, type, usability and skeptic (14a). Soul and style's love of the typed glass is kept through the status line and cursor.
(2) Drop the steel cords from the quote heads and use a dotted leader: system, interaction and skeptic (14a), with feedback's 'fiddly' note.
(3) Plans cell: widen the name column so names sit on one line and enlarge the radar back to the parent's scope: soul, style, interaction, type, usability and skeptic (14a).
(4) Move Finish setting up below the greeting so the glass opens the page: style and interaction (14a), and interaction in the landing panel.
(5) Raise the body type a step and add darkspace between cells: system (14a, landing), type (landing), style (14a carried: 'everything small and evenly weighted').
(6) Ideas kind keys as a key row plus a select with a Restaurants shortcut, with More filters above the fold: system, usability and interaction (14a and landing).
(7) Vary and lighten the rack, since not every page needs the left tube: style and system (landing), interaction, system and skeptic (14a carried: 'racks cramped', 'list in a narrow column'). Also skeptic's 'fill or collapse the chat page's empty left column'.
(8) The box should look like a field, with a matte well and a non-green placeholder: usability (landing).
(9) A faint top highlight so the bare panels read as made surfaces: feedback (14a). This is answered by the seam's lip.
(10) Strengthen the row afterglow: soul (landing), feedback.

briefs.avoids: It answers 'plan.' stranded on its own VT323 line, read as a broken wrap (system, interaction, type, usability, skeptic). It answers the steel cords as ornament (feedback, system, interaction, skeptic), and the dense, boxy, small, evenly weighted Home (all eight lenses across the landing panel and 14a). Plans names wrapping beside a shrunken radar is fixed, as is setup leading the page and taking Tab first. Ideas' four-row kind grid and More filters at the fold are fixed. The cramped, repetitive inner racks are fixed, as are the empty Ready tubes on Settings and Chat and Chat's dead left column. The box no longer reads as a display, Chat's 60% green share comes down, and the invisible afterglow is replaced with one the stills catch. It avoids the round's recorded traps. The lead is one short straight run, not Listing's right-angled jog. Seams replace boxes rather than stretching anything. No amber ring or outline anywhere. The household row is the line's own, so it is not copied from anyone. The title is not shared with another line, which answers the convergence lesson. GIVES UP: the steel patch cords in heads, the VT323 title line, setup as the page's first line (which usability liked; it is still first under the greeting), the 1px boxed panels on Home, the left rack on Plans, Chat, Settings, Family, Memory, Wishes and the form, the Ideas kind-key grid, and the 'Now' word in the month cell.
briefs.title: 'Send Vera anything to *plan.*' (lit word 'plan', the full stop inside the lit run). One sentence, one face: Plex Sans condensed 600 in bone on the glass, with only 'plan.' hot-cored and haloed. If it wraps, it breaks before 'to'. It has NOT been tried. It says FamilyDB's job: you hand Vera anything (a weekend, a reminder, an idea, a wish, a calendar question) and she plans it. It names who hears you and works as the box's own label. 'Anything' takes in every kind of item, and as an imperative it cannot be answered 'no' (the old 'Anything to plan?' failed only as a yes/no question). 'Send' is the videotex keystroke, the ENVOI key of the line's sommaire. It is also the word on the green primary under the box, so the label and the button read as one instruction: you write it, you Send it. It also takes this line off 'Give Vera something to plan.', which seven crosses shared in 14a and which Desk keeps in this heat.
